_lane: GH#397 round 2 — lane l5 (regions: liscor, inn)
_note: Every `new` value was read out of the named script's own qa_output/<script>/events.jsonl after a real headless run at the canonical seed, never hand-typed; each script re-ran green afterwards.

work_loop.old: The tables are covered. Nothing more to carry out until tomorrow.
work_loop.new: Every table out there has its plate. The tray stands empty by the counter until tomorrow's service.

wrong_order_loop.old: The order's a mess and you haven't the first idea how to stretch it. Not yet.
wrong_order_loop.new: One pot of stock and three plates called for. Stretching the one across the three is a cook's trick, and you have not got it.

archer_earn_loop.old: You put an arrow in the straw. Not bad, for someone who still flinches at the draw.
archer_earn_loop.new: The arrow goes into the straw a hand left of the cluster at chest height. You walk down and pull it out for the next one.

archer_earn_loop.old: You have shot your quiver dry for today. The straw will keep.
archer_earn_loop.new: Your quiver is empty, and every shaft of it is standing in the straw. Pulling them and shooting again is tomorrow's work.

guild_interior_walkthrough.old: A second board, smaller and less official: lost gear, room-for-rent scraps, one challenge to a duel that's clearly gone unanswered a long time. Anything worth chasing copies into your journal as a lead: a name and a place, nothing promised.
guild_interior_walkthrough.new: The smaller board, and nobody official keeps it: lost gear, rooms going spare, one duel challenge with nothing written under it. What is worth chasing copies into your journal as a lead, with a name and a place to start from.

property_seams.old: [Basic Cleaning] — You take it off in three passes. The dried mud lifts, the grain comes up pale, and the boards stop smelling of the road.
property_seams.new: [Basic Cleaning] — The dried mud breaks up under the cloth and goes off the edge of the table in flakes. What is left is pale grain, dry to the touch.

gate_district_walkthrough.old: Silverfang goods, honest prices. A sign on the cloth says she remembers faces, and debts; the Gnoll shopkeeper herself is off up the row, working a price upward.
gate_district_walkthrough.new: Silverfang goods, honest prices, and a card on the cloth that says the seller remembers faces and debts. Krshia is four stalls up the row with her back to you, working a price upward.

delivery_loop.old: Silverfang goods, honest prices. The plains-wool bolt you carried up sits shelved at eye level, already half-sold by the yard. She moves what's good — and remembers who brought it.
delivery_loop.new: The plains-wool bolt you carried up stands at eye level on the near stand, cut into and already half gone by the yard. A customer has the end of it in both hands, arguing the price down.

unit_test_pins.old: Your own bed, and a mattress that no longer remembers the last guest.
unit_test_pins.new: The mattress has fresh straw in it and the blanket has been beaten out. It smells of soap and nothing else.
